cultural.vision_reason: Studio portrait of two named Otoe men, Baptiste Deroin (interpreter, in Western dress) and Buffalo Chief (head chief of the Buffalo Band) wearing a fur turban with eagle feathers, ear ornaments, beaded choker, beaded wool leggings, blanket, and holding a tomahawk — documentary photo of Otoe dress and regalia.

physical.title: photographic print (black and white); album
physical.summary:
Photograph (black and white) from an album; studio portrait of two Otoe men, Baptiste Deroin, an Otoe interpreter, standing; and Buffalo Chief (Cha-Wan-Na-Ga-He), head chief of the Buffalo Band, seated; Baptiste Deroin wears a brimmed felt hat, necklace, tie, shirt, vest, suit jacket, trousers and leather shoes; Buffalo Chief wears a decorated fur turban with two eagle feathers, ear ornaments, beaded choker and necklaces, a peace medal, wool leggings with beadwork decoration and fringe, a wool blanket around his waist and moccasins; holding a tomahawk; Washington, D.C, USA. 
Albumen print
